measurement_limits: Default-off timing is mixed; unchanged point algorithm means positive legs are not proof of a root optimization. All adverse legs retained.
Observer comparison measures total existing-plus-new profiling overhead, not an isolated incremental cost of the three new stages.
Diagnostic point spans are inclusive wall time; they do not establish unprofiled CPU savings.
Native/SDK/Sidecar/raw SQLite have different abstraction costs; three-engine floor is bounded workload evidence, not whole-engine superiority.
